blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre estoicismo a partir de um diário em blog, relatando reflexões pessoais com ritmo e ênfase adequados.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Notes from the Commuter Train: Marcus Aurelius
paras: I have been **reading** the *Meditations* on the 7:40 train. The Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius **wrote them as notes to himself**, much of it **while on campaign**, and that explains the tone: **no polish, no audience**, only a man **reminding himself** to **keep his temper**.

What **strikes me** is the **practicality**. “**You have power over your mind, not outside events**,” he writes, in effect. **Realise this, and you will find strength**. This morning, **stuck behind a signal failure**, I **tried it**. The delay **did not vanish**, but **my irritation did**.
**I do not claim** to be a Stoic. **If anything**, I am a **reluctant** one. **But** every journey now **ends** with a small **question**: *what was in my control today?*

items.q: Marcus Aurelius wrote the Meditations for a public audience.
The writer calls himself a committed Stoic.
items.why: I do not claim to be a Stoic.

head: Recurso
Exemplo
Efeito
rows: The delay **did not vanish**, but my irritation did.
**If anything**, I am a reluctant one.

blocks.body: Imperativo + **and** + futuro = condicional resumido: *Realise this, and you will…*. **If anything** suaviza uma afirmação: *se alguma coisa*.
*Stoic* (com maiúscula, escola) × *stoic* (calmo): o segundo é um adjetivo comum.

items.s: I have been ___ the Meditations on the train. (read, -ing)
Realise this, and you ___ find strength. (will)
___ anything, I am a reluctant one. (if)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Keep one’s cool** — manter a calma
**Roll with the punches** — adaptar-se aos golpes
**Take it in one’s stride** — encarar com serenidade
**Weather the storm** — enfrentar a tempestade
**Grin and bear it** — aguentar firme
**Keep calm and carry on** — manter a calma e seguir
**Count to ten** — contar até dez
**Let it go** — deixar para lá
**Come to terms with** — aceitar
**Make peace with** — fazer as pazes com
**What are you reading?** — O que você está lendo?
**Does it help with delays?** — Ajuda com os atrasos?
**The delay stays, but my irritation fades.** — O atraso fica, mas a irritação passa.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: What strikes me is how practical he is.
Realise this, and you will find strength.
If anything, I am a reluctant Stoic.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence blog entry about applying an ancient idea to a daily irritation.
blocks.model: I have been reading a Stoic handbook at lunch. What strikes me is how practical it is. Accept what you cannot change, and you will waste less energy. Today the queue at the bank did not shorten, but my temper did. If anything, I am a reluctant student. Tomorrow I shall try it again.

items.why: **rush-hour carriage** = vagão da hora do rush.
